displayName: Strawberries and Alfalfa (keep apart: tarnished plant bug)

keepApart.reason: Tarnished plant bugs build up in alfalfa and move into strawberries, especially when the alfalfa is cut
keepApart.source: NC State Extension, Lorena Lopez, "Tarnished Plant Bug in Strawberries" (2014, revised 2026-04-17), https://content.ces.ncsu.edu/tarnished-plant-bug-in-strawberries
